title: SQL Injection Prevention: Parameterized Queries vs String Concatenation
realWorldScenario: A junior developer writes: `const query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + req.body.email + "'";`
questionStatement: Why is this code vulnerable to SQL Injection? What payload could an attacker submit, and how do Parameterized Queries (Prepared Statements) prevent this?
expectedConcepts: SQL Injection vulnerability through string concatenation
Separation of code and data in Prepared Statements ($1 / ?)
hints: Show how an attacker closes the quote and injects boolean tautology.
